prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Test Your Pet's Desktop Controls", "Try moving your companion around the desktop and testing interaction shortcuts before finishing.", "Interactive Desktop Pet Preview", "Complete Onboarding", "Interactive Desktop Pet Preview"]
1: ["Customize Pet Personality", "Select traits that define how your pet behaves on your desktop."]
2: ["Signing in automatically syncs and restores any existing pets saved to your cloud account."]
3: ["Preparing Your Desktop Companion", "We are assembling your pet's graphics and setting up desktop interaction drivers.", "1. Generating pet graphics\n2. Verifying desktop display bounds\n3. Syncing companion AI"]
4: ["How Would You Like to Create Your Pet?", "Choose between instant adoption from our species catalog or creating a custom pet from photos.", "Adopt Classic Companion vs Create Custom Pet", "Adopt Classic Companion vs Create Custom Pet"]
5: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your new companion a name to finalize their adoption registration.", "Live Companion Mascot Preview", "Enter Pet Name", "Enter Pet Name"]
6: ["Welcome Your Companion Home", "Learn Controls"]
7: ["A New Companion Is Waiting For You", "Every desktop needs a friendly companion. Let's find or create yours."]
8: ["Secure Your Pet to the Cloud", "Sign in to save your pet's memory, custom traits, and restore them anytime on any device.", "Continue & Save Pet Cloud Profile"]
9: ["You will receive a system alert on your desktop when your pet is ready to spawn."]
